vulnerability.name: USN-7890-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that FFmpeg did not properly handle the parsing of certain malformed HLS playlists. If a user were tricked into opening a specially crafted HLS playlist, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause FFmpeg to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

statements.status_notes: FFmpeg could be made to crash if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
